name: The Gaffer
subtitle: Sam's Father
game_text: <phase>Fellowship</phase>: Exert The Gaffer to heal Frodo or Sam.
flavor_text: “No one had a more attentive audience than old Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer. He held forth at The Ivy Bush, a small inn on the Bywater road; and he spoke with some authority, for he had tended the garden at Bag End for forty years....”
